title: Sauce Demo Shopify Homepage and Navigation Overview
content: The homepage of https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/ features a top navigation bar with a menu hamburger icon (button[aria-label="Open navigation menu"]) that opens a side navigation menu. The side menu can be closed with a button (button[aria-label="Close menu"]). The homepage provides access to store Q&A, collection browsing, and cart management. There is a 'Log in' button (a[href="/account/login"]) in the top navigation that leads to the login/account authentication flow, either as a modal or a separate page. The layout supports both desktop and mobile navigation, and the main user flows include browsing products, accessing account features, and managing the shopping cart.
